name: What factors affect the cost of kitchen drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of kitchen drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen drywall repair costs depend on the size of the hole, whether water damage is present, and the level of finish required. Small puncture repairs from relocated electrical boxes or cabinet hardware sit on the lower end of the cost spectrum. Larger projects involving cutouts behind kitchen sinks, plumbing access points, or high-level smooth finishes beneath semi-gloss paint require more labor, multiple site visits for mud drying, and specialized priming, which increases the total cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include the size of the damage, access behind cabinets or appliances, water damage remediation needs, and the texture matching required.
